Audit & Compliance

Structured audit management across regulatory frameworks. Every finding, action, and closure recorded against the inspectable record.

OverviewTimelineFormsFacility MappingAudit & Compliance

Audit Capabilities

How audit management works

Audit records are structured objects — not unstructured notes. Each audit type has defined fields, required evidence, and a lifecycle enforced by the system.

Scheduled Audits

Define recurring audit schedules tied to regulatory cycles. Each audit instance is tracked from creation through completion, with evidence attached at each step.

Unannounced Inspection Readiness

Maintain a live compliance posture so that the record state at any moment reflects actual operational status. No preparation window required.

Evidence & Attachment Management

Attach documents, photographs, and signed observations directly to audit findings. Evidence is stored against the relevant entity and retrievable by inspectors.

Corrective Action Tracking

Log required actions from audit findings with assigned owner, due date, and resolution status. Actions remain open until formally closed with supporting evidence.

Audit Lifecycle

From schedule to closure

1

Schedule

Quality Manager

Audit defined with type, scope, target date, and assigned auditor. Linked to regulatory framework if applicable.

2

Conduct

Auditor

Auditor completes checklist items, attaches evidence, and records observations against each standard or criterion.

3

Findings

Auditor

Non-conformances, observations, and positive findings recorded with severity classification. Each finding generates a trackable record.

4

Corrective Actions

Service Manager

Actions assigned to responsible parties with due dates. Progress tracked in system. Overdue items flagged automatically.

5

Review & Close

Quality Manager

Completed actions reviewed and verified. Audit formally closed with sign-off. Full audit trail retained for inspection.

Regulatory Context

Supported frameworks

Acutis is designed for the regulatory environment in Ireland and Northern Ireland. Audit structures and compliance tracking align with the standards applied by each authority.

HIQA

Health Information and Quality Authority

Ireland's independent authority responsible for monitoring, inspecting, and regulating health and social care services.

Applicable to

  • Disability
  • Mental Health
  • Children's Residential
RQIA

Regulation and Quality Improvement Authority

Northern Ireland's independent health and social care regulatory and improvement body.

Applicable to

  • Residential Care
  • Nursing Homes
  • Day Care
HSE

Health Service Executive Standards

Service-level compliance requirements applicable to HSE-funded and HSE-operated care services.

Applicable to

  • Section 38/39 Services
  • Primary Care
  • Community Services
